summary: Preserve module export linkage for exported namespace.

source.pattern: export namespace N { export const x=1 }

target.notes: Model observable JavaScript emitted by TypeScript first, then reuse canonical JS class/module/object semantics.

tests.name: runtime export
tests.input: export namespace N { export const x=1 }
tests.expected_behavior: module exports runtime N object with x=1

tests.name: function member
tests.input: export namespace N { export function f(){return 1} }
